children: Thryv entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement with Coldwater YP to sell its Yellow and White Pages directories in the U.S., Australia and New Zealand, the digital editions of those directories, and Australia White Pages for $142 million in cash, subject to adjustments. The agreement includes customary representations, warranties and insurance, with closing subject to standard conditions. Thryv expects the divestiture to streamline its portfolio and sharpen focus on its SaaS platform.
